Class HumanPlayer

java.lang.Object
np.cincuentazo.model.Player
np.cincuentazo.model.HumanPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Playable
public class HumanPlayer extends Player
Represents the human player in a Cincuentazo game.

Role in MVC

This class is pure model: it holds no reference to any UI component. The controller is the bridge between UI events (mouse clicks on card slots) and this class's selectCard(int, int) method.

How a human turn works

  1. The controller enables card-click events on the UI.
  2. The player clicks a card â€” the view fires an event with the card's index.
  3. The controller receives the event and calls selectCard(index, tableSum).
  4. If the play is valid, the card is returned; if not, InvalidPlayException is thrown and the UI can display an error without crashing.

  • Method Details

    • selectCard

      public Card selectCard(int cardIndex, int tableSum) throws InvalidPlayException
      Plays the card at the given index on behalf of the human player.

      This method is called by the controller after the human has clicked a card in the UI. The controller passes the clicked card's index and the current table sum for validation.

      The method delegates directly to Hand.removeCard(int, int), which performs the legality check and extracts the card atomically.

      Specified by:

      Specified by:

      tableSum - current table sum at the moment of play
      Returns:

      Throws:
